explanation: This fires only at D2 of trials where the agent chose a1 (it is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and 0 to 2 at D2 after choosing a2, whichever state was reached), and its level rises with the trial number: about 3 at D2 for trials 0-30, about 5-7 for trials 60-85, and 9-10 for trials 88-99. Subtract 1-2 when the a1 choice ended in the rare state S2, comes right after an unrewarded trial, or is the agents first a1 after a run of a2 choices (then it is about 2-3 below the usual level).
